name: Anjou Hajime
source:
"Wow, I sense something spooky. I'm so excited~"

The eccentric owner and barista of the café, the Night Owl. He allows [url=/c84005]Arata[/url] to use his café as a place of refuge while on the run from the authorities. He is an avid consumer of occult literature and moderates occult forums online. His knowledge might come in handy...

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
